rites.name: Tiranaari
rites.text: Tiranaari is a rite of the Walled Age in which the orders of Draktak raise a line of signal-fires across the holding walls to bind their garrisons in a single act of consecration. Its flames are said to burn through the ramparts of a rival fortress in a single night, ending centuries of siege.

rites.name: Gaithornurn
rites.text: Gaithornurn is a sealed wardstone of the Martial realm's sixth era, carved to hold a single discipline of combat rites that the old duelling masters forbade their apprentices to speak aloud. Three centuries ago it was buried beneath a training ground so that no duellist could claim its ward-craft as their own. Those who have touched it report a faint hum that rises whenever a blade is drawn nearby.

rites.name: Keludeston
rites.text: Keludeston is a concept of the Draktak omniverse, a rule of how a single oath can fracture into three competing endings. Within the Martial Realm of the Age of Sundering, it is said to be the force that splits one landfall into many shelved futures.
